notes.title: v0.2 Marine Animals Big Update
notes.notes:
☑ Added up to 50 marine creatures, including Dunkleosteus, Styxosaurus, Mosasaur, Anomalocaris, Ammonite, Great White Shark, Bull Shark, Blue Whale, Manta Ray, Giant Squid, Sunfish, Dolphin, and various small tropical fish, etc.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743241/d9767105675ad643c92a2a744ce6e76968e54ec6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743241/94108c6bf5ebb88b19826e668f67f793244b7f28.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743241/4e57091c17db1feb3d179dbef71fbf72578c3a7e.jpg[/img]
☑ Note: Re-adjusted the craft logic. You must put both the raw materials and fuel into the campfire or furnace inventory before you can make the item through the craft list
☑ Added a mission management interface where you can activate and cancel mission 
☑ Add the function of inputting the quantity to crat items. Enter the quantity you want to make in the input box next to the crat button
☑ Reduced the number of resources required to tame pets
☑ Fixed the problem of incorrect display of survival time
☑ Hide the line display of prohibited construction areas
☑ Automatically calculate the number of resources required for repair according to the degree of damage to the building
☑ Set animal fat as fuel, which can be added to campfires and furnaces as fuel
☑ Fixed the problem of returning to the respawn point when dismounting in single-player mode
☑ Fixed after death, click here to respawn and you will return to the bed
☑ Reduce the food consumption rate of pets
☑ Adjust the sky of the rainforest map, reduce the number of AI, optimize the light source distance culling, turn off global illumination, and increase the frame rate by 30FPS.  
☑ When the pet stays in place, reduce excessive food/water consumption, and consume more food when attacking
☑ Save the game time to the archive, and use the time in the archive next time you load
☑ Adjust the craft interface to prevent users from entering invalid text
☑ Fix the engine bug that causes the lamp to be unable to be removed under certain conditions
☑ Optimize the inventory addition algorithm to increase the execution speed of the "Tidy" and "pick up all" actions, from the visible card of 1 second to the imperceptible
☑ Fix the bug of taking all away function to generates a large number of items
☑ Fix some stones floating in the air
☑ Reduce the attenuation distance of dinosaur sound effects
☑ UI adjustment and optimization
☑ Add a small fish icon to the fishing trap for easy finding
☑ Add fishing trap to catch more fish: oysters
☑ Reduce the brightness at night
☑ Optimize the lighting and shadows of wall lamps,  torches, and flashlights, remove the distance of 100 meters, and build too many lighting props to generate too much light, which will greatly reduce fps
☑ Localization translation calibration
☑ Add a icon for the bed to mark the location of the home
☑ Split item prompt: Shift+ Left click and drag items
☑Add support for more countries Localization language translation: Dutch, Swedish, Portuguese-Portugal, Hungarian, Danish, Norwegian, Czech, Greek, Ukrainian, Romanian, Finnish, Spanish-Latin America, Bulgarian, Vietnamese
☑Adjust the character customization interface
☑ When taming a dinosaur, the "Tame a pet" goal prompt is not completed
☑ Automatically display several items that can be crafted when the mouse hovers over the materials
☑ Take all items function optimization, support tidy any inventory

notes.title: v0.13 Major update: Player skill upgrade system
notes.notes:
☑ New player skill upgrade system, you can choose to upgrade the three major skills of Survival, Agility, and Power, with dozens of detailed skill tree branches built in.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743241/06b6ae01f2a315515f6af1a70ce3f08a03e1fa9e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743241/a38f95243aeb4a2de116021505fdd38a53e5462c.png[/img]
You can see the player level when upgrading or in the skill upgrade interface. The player level can unlock skills of different levels and types. Killing dinosaurs or building, cutting trees, mining ore, fishing, crafting items and other behaviors can gain experience
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743241/8c31a52642214a46110735da3b02e257bc22c3fb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743241/46ee861e36d45010a42460b7bd8f913dfeba2ad6.png[/img]
☑ Shorten the night time of 2 maps and increase the brightness at night
☑ Adjust the initial time of the map to sunrise
☑ Block construction near the NPC traders to prevent other players from building and blocking trade
☑ Improve the distribution of stone resources in the rainforest map
☑ Adjust the size of the moon and the scattering effect of moonlight beams
☑ Map and landscape optimization
☑ Add an option switch to turn off camera shaking when running to reduce dizziness, set in the menu options
☑ UI adjustment and optimization
☑ Add the display of the in-game clock in the lower left corner
☑ Fix the mission system cannot recognize the task of completing the taming of pets
☑ Fix the problem of cauldron
☑ Adjust the riding position of some dinosaurs
☑ Fixed the sliding problem of some dinosaur running animations
☑ Fixed the problem that you can't press E to open the death bag after dying in water
☑ Fixed the problem that melee weapons attacking dinosaurs will knock dinosaurs away
☑ Set to restore 10HP by eating cooked meat
☑ Set herbivorous dinosaurs to eat leaves
☑ The character's speed will slow down and the stamina consumption will increase in bad weather
☑ Reset the amount of loot for looting AI
☑ Fixed the respawn point of the small bed is not in the center of the bed after setting the respawn point
☑ Fixed you may receive fall damage after getting off a tall dinosaur
☑ Fixed sometimes the password is wrong due to the localization of the password text
☑ Adjust the minimum critical damage to +30%, adjust the fluctuation range of the damage value
☑ Reset the AI's loot and reduce the AI's HP recovery speed
☑ Fixed the bug that the correct password prompt of the door lock system is incorrect
☑ Multiplayer game save: Improve the clarity of how save works in multiplayer games
☑ Reduced the hostility probability of some herbivorous dinosaurs
☑ Slow down the speed at which dinosaurs consume food and water
☑ Fixed the problem of opening the wrong inventory interface
☑ Fixed the problem of loading archives failing due to uninitialized player id
☑ Fixed the problem that the Archaeopteryx will fly around after death
